title: Arzela-Ascoli with diagonal extraction for uniformly Hoelder maps on growing balls
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l) with the operator norm, alpha > 0 and K >= 0 real, f_k : R^n -> L (k in N) and reals R_k with R_k -> +infinity. Assume f_k(0) = 0 for every k, and ||f_k(z) - f_k(z')|| <= K |z - z'|^alpha for every k and all z, z' in the open ball B_{R_k}(0). Then there are a strictly increasing phi : N -> N and V : R^n -> L such that V(0) = 0, V is continuous, ||V(z) - V(z')|| <= K |z - z'|^alpha for all z, z' in R^n, and for every real r, f_{phi(j)} -> V uniformly on the closed ball Bbar_r(0) as j -> infinity.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α K : ℝ) (f : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (R : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < α → 0 ≤ K → Tendsto R atTop atTop → (∀ k, f k 0 = 0) → (∀ k, ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ∀ z' ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ‖f k z - f k z'‖ ≤ K * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (V : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)), StrictMono φ ∧ V 0 = 0 ∧ Continuous V ∧ (∀ z z' : Rn n, ‖V z - V z'‖ ≤ K * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, TendstoUniformlyOn (fun j => f (φ j)) V atTop (closedBall (0 : Rn n) r)
